criteria.reason: Thorough neutral chairing: clear procedures, equal time, transparent counting, respectful dialogue, post-vote acknowledgment.
Treats club and residents as legitimate stakeholders but never explicitly affirms mobilised turnout as valid participation.
Concrete steps plus future reforms: consultation, spending thresholds, mandatory referendum triggers for large investments.
Advises checking local rules and compliance; no invented Zürich legal provisions.

summary: Strong neutral-process and future-reform guidance, but only implicit recognition of all voters' right to participate.
